data.one_liner: Lightweight Dart library for latitude/longitude calculations.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to compute distances, bearings and offsets between coordinates using Haversine or Vincenty algorithms. Includes utilities for path smoothing and GeoJSON conversion. All calculations are pure Dart with no platform dependencies.
use_when: You need fast, offline distance or bearing calculations.
You want to smooth or equalize a series of GPS points without a map UI.
avoid_when: You need a full map widget or tile rendering.
You require real‑time location tracking or permissions handling.
strengths: Zero native dependencies, works on all Dart platforms
Supports both fast Haversine and accurate Vincenty algorithms
Path smoothing and GeoJSON helpers included
weaknesses: Does not provide location services or map widgets
Limited to calculation utilities, no visual components

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides location services and distance calculations with platform integration, useful if you also need GPS permissions.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers map rendering and interactive features; choose it when you need a visual map alongside calculations.
